description: This file contains setup, fixture, hook, and utility functions for behave-based testing, including active tag management, fixture registration, and environment setup.

classes.name: ActiveTagMatcher
classes.description: Class used for matching and skipping features, rules, or scenarios based on active tags.

methods.name: print_active_tags_summary
methods.description: Prints a summary of active tags for debugging or informational purposes.

methods.name: behave_no_background
methods.description: Fixture to disable background inheritance for a scenario.

methods.name: behave_disable_background_inheritance
methods.description: Fixture to disable background inheritance for a rule.

methods.name: before_all
methods.description: Hook executed before all tests; sets up active tags, environment, and command shell.

methods.name: before_feature
methods.description: Hook executed before each feature; skips feature if active tag matcher indicates so.

methods.name: before_rule
methods.description: Hook executed before each rule; skips rule if active tag matcher indicates so.

methods.name: before_scenario
methods.description: Hook executed before each scenario; skips scenario if active tag matcher indicates so.

methods.name: before_tag
methods.description: Hook executed before each tag; applies fixtures based on tag prefix.

methods.name: setup_context_with_global_params_test
methods.description: Sets global parameters in context for testing.

methods.name: setup_python_path
methods.description: Sets the PYTHONPATH environment variable for the process.
